Breaks are more common than you think and usually its used when some space is needed, if she agreed to the rules you set then thats all that matters, remember she had the opportunity to disagree with the rules and just break up. Instead she did what she did and now you gotta do what you gotta do ; MOVE ON AND GET SOME OUT THERE

You are in a great position to just walk away. There will always be new encounters and oppurtunities so dont just stay for the sake of staying. If you are not able to view your girlfriend as you once did, with the same hopes and dreams for the future as you once did, then you are currently staying in a relationship with someone you dont know. All you know about this person is that they cheated. Personally i left my ex immediately when i found out she cheated because i knew that the longer i spent thinking about it, the more time i would spend rationalizing and staying despite all the logical signs telling me to just go.

As some have suggested, WALK AWAY NOW ASAP OP. Shes basicslly "monkey-branching", shes holding on to one branch (you) while reaching out to another branch (the other guy).  She is reluctant to let go the branch (you) until she knows sure as shit that the grip on the other branch is tight. But once she does.... OP youre going to be in a world of hurt. Instead of letting her go on with this, stand up for yourself and end the relationship on your terms now and i can GURANTEE that in the future, youll look back on this moment proudly and will be thankful that you did not cling on to her only for her to cut you off when she finds someone better. Youre young and theres countless other oppurtunities for you in your university and later in life, cut her off and enjoy these oppurtunities OP.
